issues.problem: lv 4 is too low: にしては is N3 grammar, so the hardest item in every sentence is at least N3.
issues.action: Set lv to 3 on all 16 lines that had lv 4.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}忙[いそが]しい{にしては|nishitewa}、毎日[まいにち]ちゃんと料理[りょうり]{を|o-object}します。
issues.problem: にしては after a bare i-adjective (忙しいにしては) is unnatural; an adjective takes わりに, so the sentence modelled the wrong particle.
issues.action: Rewrote with a verb premise: 母は毎晩遅くまで働いているにしては、毎日ちゃんと料理をします。 (f=2), English and why updated.

issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さん{は|wa-topic}入社[にゅうしゃ]して間[ま]もない{わりに|wari-ni}、仕事[しごと]{を|o-object}よく分[わ]かっています。
issues.problem: 分かる takes が in standard Japanese; 仕事を分かっている is colloquial and should not be modelled.
issues.action: Changed to 仕事{が|ga-stative}よく分かっています.

issues.jp_before: この仕事[しごと]{は|wa-topic}忙[いそが]しい{わりに|wari-ni}、給料[きゅうりょう]{が|ga-subject}安[やす]いです。
issues.problem: Awkward English ('the pay is low for that'); 給料は is an equally natural alternative; lv 4 is too low for わりに (N3).
issues.action: English rewritten, slot made {が/は|ga-subject}, lv set to 3.

issues.jp_before: 姉[あね]{は|wa-topic}英語[えいご]{が|ga-stative}得意[とくい]な{わりに|wari-ni}、海外[かいがい]{に|ni-destination}行[い]ったことがありません。
issues.problem: へ is equally natural for the destination but was missing; English word order was awkward.

issues.jp_before: この会議[かいぎ]{は|wa-topic}長[なが]い{わりに|wari-ni}、決[き]まったこと{が|ga-subject}少[すく]ないです。
issues.problem: The tenses clashed (この会議は長い + 決まったこと) and the English mixed present and past; は was missing as an alternative.
issues.action: Rewrote as その会議は長かったわりに、決まったこと{が/は}少なかったです。 with matching English.

issues.jp_before: この大学[だいがく]{は|wa-topic}学費[がくひ]{が|ga-subject}高[たか]い{わりに|wari-ni}、設備[せつび]{は|wa-contrast}古[ふる]いです。
issues.problem: 設備が古い is equally natural; the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}図書館[としょかん]{で|de-place}毎日[まいにち]勉強[べんきょう]している{わりに|wari-ni}、まだ漢字[かんじ]{を|o-object}よく間違[まちが]えます。
issues.problem: This was the second 彼 subject in the file (the rules prefer roles or names), so the file lacked variety.
issues.action: Subject changed to 弟; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{の|no-possessive}宿題[しゅくだい]{は|wa-topic}量[りょう]{が|ga-subject}多[おお]い{わりに|wari-ni}、簡単[かんたん]でした。
issues.problem: Unnatural English ('large in volume but easy for that').
issues.action: English rewritten: 'Today's homework was easy, considering how much of it there was.'

issues.jp_before: 同僚[どうりょう]{は|wa-topic}パソコン{が|ga-stative}苦手[にがて]な{わりに|wari-ni}、いつも資料[しりょう]{を|o-object}きれいに作[つく]ります。
issues.problem: Unnatural English ('yet always makes neat documents for that').
issues.action: English rewritten: 'For someone who is bad with computers, my colleague always makes neat documents.'

issues.jp_before: 一[いっ]か月[げつ]{を通[とお]して/を通[つう]じて|wotooshite}、毎日[まいにち]同[おな]じバス{に|ni-destination}乗[の]りました。
issues.problem: を通して for a span of time is unnatural with a short span like 一か月 (a native would say 一か月間), and バスに乗る is not a destination に, so the skill id was wrong.
issues.action: Rewrote the item in place, keeping the same skill: 友人を通して駅前のアパートを見つけました。 (intermediary use).

issues.jp_before: 姉妹都市[しまいとし]{の|no-possessive}交流[こうりゅう]{を通[とお]して/を通[つう]じて|wotooshite}、二[ふた]つ{の|no-possessive}町[まち]{の|no-possessive}人々[ひとびと]{は|wa-topic}仲良[なかよ]くなりました。
issues.problem: 人々が is equally natural here; the alternative was missing.
